briefing.headline: Mixed overnight with modest tech gains and sharp moves in niche stocks
briefing.summary: The major US tech names showed small upticks, with NVDA and AMD edging higher while MSFT and AAPL slipped slightly. Broad market indices (SPY, QQQ) were essentially flat. Semiconductor exposure saw notable activity as MU rose nearly 2% and leveraged SOXL gained about 1.9%, whereas the energy‑related ITG tumbled over 28%. Smaller‑cap tokens like SMMT and MAAS posted large gains, contrasting with steep declines in AAUC and TBN, indicating a split market breadth.
